opportunities.title: Correct the VinSolutions Sales schedule Lead-Intent selection to Sales-only
opportunities.trigger: The ROI, CAGE, and daily Sales Communication scheduled reports positively select Service/Parts Lead-Intents (Parts, Service), so every delivery is quarantined whole under the Sales-only data contract.
opportunities.action: In VinSolutions report scheduling, set Lead-Intent to Sales-only (remove Acquisition, Parts, Service, Unknown), then re-deliver the affected weekly and daily periods so ROI, CAGE, and Communication metrics can land accepted.
opportunities.prerequisites: VinSolutions report-scheduling access for each rooftop.
opportunities.safety_limits: Huminic makes no schedule change; this is a recommendation only. No customer or CRM action.
opportunities.approval_needed: Explicit Duane approval before any VinSolutions schedule change.
opportunities.rationale: Unlocks the largest block of currently withheld metrics (Leads and ROI, Team/CAGE, Communications) across all three rooftops.

opportunities.title: Activate Huminic messaging and SMS engagement
opportunities.trigger: Engagement metrics (reply rate, conversations, safety-net resurrections) have no governed source; the messaging hub has zero threads for this rooftop.
opportunities.action: Onboard the rooftop to the Huminic messaging hub so reply rate, conversations held, and after-hours resurrections become measurable and coachable.
opportunities.safety_limits: No outbound messaging is activated in this test; onboarding only.
opportunities.approval_needed: Standard onboarding approval; no automation is enabled here.
opportunities.rationale: Turns an unmeasured channel into a governed, coachable one and creates a Huminic expansion path.

opportunities.title: Stand up a same-day appointment no-show follow-up alert
opportunities.trigger: Observed appointments this week: 18 total, 12 shown, 4 no-show, 6 confirmed (counts, not a benchmark score).
opportunities.action: Enable an internal alert to the sales manager when a Sales appointment is a no-show, so the rep re-engages the same day. A future automation could offer a reschedule text, but it is NOT activated in this test.
opportunities.prerequisites: Accepted Appointments feed (present for this rooftop).
opportunities.safety_limits: Dispatch disabled; internal recipient only; no customer contact in this test.
opportunities.approval_needed: Automation activation (customer-facing reschedule text) requires separate explicit approval.
opportunities.rationale: No-show recovery is a same-day, low-cost lever the manager can own immediately.

opportunities.title: Manager review of the lead-to-sold funnel
opportunities.trigger: Observed this week: 96 leads, 18 appts set, 12 appts shown, 5 sold (counts only; dealer baseline is insufficient, so no scoring).
opportunities.action: Walk the funnel stages (leads -> appts set -> shown -> sold) in the weekly meeting to find the largest drop-off; treat as directional context, not a graded benchmark.
opportunities.safety_limits: No industry benchmark is scored; comparisons are non-scoring until >= 3 dealer periods exist.
opportunities.rationale: Uses the one governed weekly source to focus coaching without over-claiming.

opportunities.title: Accumulate at least 3 governed weekly periods to unlock the dealer baseline
opportunities.trigger: Only one accepted weekly period exists, so a dealer-baseline trend and z-score band cannot be computed yet.
opportunities.action: Keep the weekly Sales-only deliveries flowing; the dealer baseline unlocks once three governed periods are accepted.
opportunities.rationale: Cheap, time-based unlock for trend-based diagnostics.

Serra Honda has governed current values this week for its appointment rates and its total gross, while leads and ROI, team communications, and messaging engagement are withheld or not yet connected; the picture is partial, and every gap is stated plainly rather than filled with a zero.
